name: Land of Nod

identification.note: "Nod" (meaning "wandering") is not identified with any known location; it names Cain's condition as much as a place.

related_people.name: Cain
related_people.role: settled here as a restless wanderer after murdering his brother Abel

description: The place east of Eden where Cain settled after God banished him for murdering his brother Abel (Genesis 4:16).
family_friendly_summary: The Land of Nod was the region east of Eden where Cain went to live after God sent him away for killing his brother Abel. Its name means "wandering."
